values.binNote: Wiki's per-instance number is DamagePerSecond/TicksPerSecond (60/4=15, etc.) and the AP coefficient is 0.45/4=0.1125; no bin row states the per-tick number directly, only the DPS (FiddleSticksW.DamagePerSecond) and tick rate (FiddleSticksW.TicksPerSecond) it is derived from.

values.quote: {{ap|120/{{#var:total_ticks}} to 360/{{#var:total_ticks}}}} {{as|(+ {{fd|{{#expr:90/{{#var:total_ticks}}}}}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|12 to 22}}% of target's '''missing''' health)}}
values.binNote: The flat/AP part (15/22.5/.../45 base, 0.1125 AP coef) is derived as DamagePerSecond/TicksPerSecond and not directly stated by any bin row (see w_2); only the missing-health percentage (PercentForTooltip) is directly named in the bin.

values.quote: {{ap|120 to 360}} {{as|(+ 90% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|12 to 22}}% of target's '''missing''' health)}}
values.binNote: Total base/AP (120-360, 0.9 AP) equals DamagePerSecond * DrainDuration (e.g. 60*2=120, 0.45*2=0.9), a derived tooltip total not itself a bin row; only the missing-health percentage (PercentForTooltip) is directly named in the bin.
Bin stores tick rate as TicksPerSecond=4 (i.e. 1/4=0.25s interval) rather than a direct interval value.

mechanics.claim: Fiddlesticks forms tethers to nearby enemies over the cast time before the damage channel begins.
mechanics.quote: forms a {{tip|tether}} between itself and each nearby enemy over the cast time, then {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to {{#var:channel_duration}} seconds

mechanics.claim: The final tick of the channel deals bonus damage based on the target's missing health, capped at 400 against monsters.
mechanics.quote: The final tick at the end of the channel deals additional {{as|magic damage}}, capped at 400 against {{tip|monsters}}.

mechanics.claim: Fiddlesticks heals itself for a portion of the pre-mitigation damage dealt by the channel.
mechanics.quote: '''Fiddlesticks''' {{tip|heals}} itself for a portion of the {{tt|pre-mitigation damage|Damage dealt before modifiers}} dealt

mechanics.claim: If the channel completes without being interrupted, 60% of the current cooldown is refunded.
mechanics.quote: If the channel was not {{tt|interrupted|e.g. by Fiddlesticks or crowd control effects}}, 60% of the {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is refunded.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield blocks the initial tether application but does not stop the damage of a tether already applied.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the tether's application but not the damage of one already applied.
